retrievalProfile.description: A classic holiday layout featuring a thick red border framing an inset portrait with a sparkling Christmas tree background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured composition where a central warm-toned photograph is encased in a wide, solid red border. The photograph features a close-up portrait on the left and a glowing, starburst-effect Christmas tree on the right, creating a balance of human subject and festive atmosphere. Typography is placed within the border margins, maintaining a clean separation from the image.
coreVisualRelationships: The red border acts as a secondary frame that dictates the placement of all text.
The warm lighting on the subject's face mirrors the golden glow of the tree lights.
The starburst effects on the tree provide a sharp, geometric texture against the soft skin tones of the portrait.
coreInvariants: Inset rectangular photograph with internal drop shadow
Warm, low-key lighting with high-contrast golden highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a medium-close-up portrait positioned in the left two-thirds of the inset image.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit, starburst-covered Christmas tree on the right side of the inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the glow to the tree, and finishes at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick red border provides significant negative space, isolating the central image and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows (background and inner shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and white (tree lights and starbursts)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows, contrasted with deep, low-value shadows in the portrait background.

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to image edges

composition.position: Top and bottom margins of the red border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different positions for consistency.
graphicDevices: Inner drop shadow on the image frame

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and clean lines.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid red background with a central rectangular inset. Inside the inset, place a warm-toned portrait of a man in a red shirt next to a Christmas tree with intense golden starburst light effects. Apply a subtle inner shadow to the inset rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white geometric sans-serif text in the top and bottom red margins. Align the top text to the left edge of the inset image and the bottom text to the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the red border solid and consistent?
Does the inset image have a visible inner shadow?
Are the tree lights rendered with sharp starburst flares?
Is the typography white and geometric?

mustRedesign: Ensure text is not a direct copy of the source wording

mustAchieve: Clean separation between border and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text bleed into the image area
Confirm warm color balance in the portrait
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Color Frame + Inset Thematic Portrait + Margin-Aligned Geometric Typography
